# Entry-strategy methodology

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Definition

The 5dd and 10dd entry methodologies translate a completed analysis into exactly two ranked cards. Rank 1 may explicitly say No actionable strategy; Rank 2 may say No second setup qualifies and explain the nearest defensible rejected candidate. The required format does not justify forcing two long entries.[^stock-entry-strategy-5-instructions-51bfbec68204b2d3][^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

## Requirements versus dated results

Both specifications preserve the original window and require objective trigger, independent confirmation category, cancellation, maximum buy/no-chase rule, supported stop/targets, economics, time stop and expiry. Default Moderate primary-target screening is 1.5:1; net economics and sizing need supplied inputs. The 5dd normal follow-through review is within 2–3 holding sessions; 10dd uses 3–5, with a session-5 review and greater attention to overnight/event risk.[^stock-entry-strategy-5-instructions-51bfbec68204b2d3][^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

The September 25 GPSO and HRTA 5dd results explicitly refuse actionability for missing executable structure or failing economics. BULL’s two horizon-specific entry reports likewise remain rejected for different combinations of schedule, liquidity, stop and first-target defects.[^gpso-c8b53800c8dec568][^hrta-e2f2954f5612304b][^bull-a75efdaf022b83d5][^bull-1b5fbb4a82ee07a0]

BNBR’s 10dd report is different: Rank 1 specifies a conditional 80–82 support hold with future confirmation tests and net-economics gates, while Rank 2 rejects the 84 breakout. Its stated cut-off state is Waiting. The existence of a detailed card does not prove a signal or fill.[^bnbr-694cd85cde8d5c1b]

## Relationships

[Reward-to-risk screening](risk-reward-screening.md), [signal/execution evidence](execution-state-evidence.md) and [fixed horizons](fixed-session-horizons.md) describe separate parts of this workflow.

> Synthesis: The entry layer narrows upstream scenario possibilities into executable requirements. It can reject a favorable illustrative ratio without contradicting the existence of rebound potential.
